name: Dead Hang
cues: Shoulders relaxed, not shrugged
Full elbow extension

name: Active (Scapular) Hang
cues: Pull shoulder blades down and back, elbows stay straight
common_faults: Bending elbows to fake the pull

name: Scapular Pull-up
cues: Depress and retract scapula only, no elbow bend
common_faults: Turning it into a mini pull-up

name: Inverted Row (High Angle)
cues: Body straight line, chest to bar

name: Inverted Row (Feet on Floor, Body Horizontal)
Feet-Elevated Ring Row
common_faults: Rings flaring out, losing straight body line

name: Negative Pull-up
cues: Control the descent, aim for 5s+

name: Strict Pull-up (Pronated)
cues: Full hang to chin over bar
No kipping

name: One-Arm Pull-up Negative
cues: Fight the drop the entire way down

name: One-Arm Pull-up
cues: Slight lean away from working arm, don't pull straight up
common_faults: Excessive body rotation to cheat the pull

name: German Hang
common_faults: Rushing into it without shoulder prep

name: Tuck Front Lever
cues: Posterior pelvic tilt
Push the bar down, don't just pull in

name: Full Front Lever
cues: Body dead straight, hips and shoulders in one line

name: Strict Bar Muscle-up
cues: Pull the bar to your hips, not your chest up to the bar

name: Standard Push-up
cues: Straight line head to heel
Full lockout at top

name: Pseudo Planche Push-up
cues: Hands by hips, lean shoulders well past hands

name: One-Arm Push-up
cues: Feet wide for stability
Resist rotating the torso

name: Parallel Bar Dip
cues: Elbows to full lockout at top
Chest down, shoulders below elbows at bottom

name: Ring Support Hold
cues: Turn rings out (RTO), arms locked

name: Planche Lean (Frog Stance Lean)
cues: Protract shoulders hard, round upper back

name: Full Planche Push-up (90° Push-up)
cues: Protract hard through the whole rep
Lean shoulders past hands before descending
common_faults: Piking hips to fake the lean
notes: Mastery tier anchor — full straight-body planche push-up range.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Knees track over toes
Hips reach full depth

name: Pistol Squat
cues: Free leg stays straight and off the floor

name: Nordic Curl
cues: Hips stay extended, hinge only at the knee

name: Hollow Body Hold (Straight)
cues: Lower back pressed to the floor
Arms and legs long

name: RKC Plank
cues: Max full-body tension, glutes and abs squeezed hard

name: L-sit
cues: Legs fully straight and parallel to floor
Shoulders depressed, not shrugged

name: Full Dragon Flag
cues: Only shoulders touch the bench, body rigid straight

name: Freestanding Handstand Hold
cues: Fingers grip the floor to fine-tune balance
Ribs stacked over pelvis

name: Weighted Push-up
cues: Plate placed high on the back, between shoulder blades

name: Ring Pull-up (RTO)
cues: Turn rings out at the top
Control the extra shoulder instability

name: Ring Support Hold (Bent-Arm Cross Lean)
cues: Turn rings out hard, lean shoulders down toward hands

name: Full Iron Cross
cues: Arms dead straight out to the sides, rings turned out

name: Plyo Push-up (Hands on Box)
cues: Explode up, land soft with bent elbows

name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades together at full stretch

name: Band Face Pull
cues: Pull to forehead height, elbows high

name: Farmer's Carry
cues: Shoulders packed down, walk tall

name: Band Pallof Press
cues: Resist rotation, press straight out and back

name: Hindu Push-up
cues: Start hips high (downward dog)
Dive chest through low, finish chest up (upward dog/cobra)
common_faults: Cutting the arc short instead of full dive-through
notes: Traditional Indian wrestling exercise; also builds shoulder/thoracic mobility.

name: Superman Push-up
cues: Full extension in the air, arms reaching forward like Superman

name: Hindu Squat (Bethak)
cues: Heels rise at the bottom
Arms swing back to front for rhythm

name: Crow Pose / Frog Stand
cues: Knees rest on the backs of the upper arms
Look slightly forward, not straight down
notes: Classic yoga/calisthenics entry point to arm balance and handstand training.

name: Squat Thrust
notes: Same as a burpee without the push-up and jump.

name: V-Up
cues: Reach hands to feet at the top, both halves lift together

name: Tuck Planche (Rings)
cues: Rings add instability on top of the tuck planche demand

name: Wrist Prep & Mobility
cues: Keep palms flat on floor
Gradually shift weight forward and sideways
notes: Essential wrist preparation before pushing or handstand work.

name: Arm Circles & Shoulder Rotations
cues: Large controlled circles
Keep arms straight
notes: Lubricates shoulder joints and primes deltoids.

name: Scapular Pull Hangs
cues: Depress scapula from dead hang
Keep arms straight

name: Dynamic Hip Swings & Openers
cues: Smooth controlled leg swings
Deep squat open-outs
notes: Prepares hips, glutes, and adductors for lower body work.

name: Hollow Body Hold & Rocks
cues: Lower back pressed flat against floor
Tuck chin to chest
notes: Core activation primer for all gymnastics and calisthenics work.

name: Cat-Cow Spinal Mobility
cues: Inhale arching back down, exhale rounding up
Move vertebra by vertebra
notes: Relieves spinal tension and improves thoracic mobility.

name: March in Place
cues: Knees to hip height
Relaxed arms swinging naturally

name: Jumping Jacks (Warm-up Pace)
cues: Land softly
Easy pace, not max effort

name: High Knees (Warm-up Pace)
cues: Light and quick, not maximal
Tall posture

name: Neck Rolls
cues: Slow and controlled
Stop if any sharp pain

name: Wrist Circles
cues: Full range both directions

name: Hip Circles
cues: Big controlled circles
Both directions

name: Ankle Circles
cues: Full range both directions
Both feet

name: Torso Twists
cues: Rotate from the core, not just arms

name: Leg Swings (Front-Back)
cues: Hold a wall for balance
Controlled, not kicking

name: Leg Swings (Lateral)
cues: Hold a wall for balance
Keep torso upright

name: Walking Lunge with Twist
cues: Twist toward the front leg
Keep front knee tracking over toes

name: Inchworm to Up-Dog
cues: Walk hands out slowly
Full extension at the top

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Deep lunge, rotate toward front leg

name: Glute Bridge Activation
cues: Squeeze glutes hard at the top
Short controlled pulses

name: Scapular Squeeze Activation
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades together and hold briefly

name: Plank to Push-up Activation
cues: Alternate leading arm each rep

name: Pogo Hops
cues: Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend
Light and quick

name: Shoulder Dislocates (Band/Stick)
cues: Wide grip to start, narrow as mobility improves
Ribs down, don't arch to fake range

name: Loaded Shoulder Flexion Stretch
cues: Build load gradually
Stop short of pinching pain

name: Shoulder CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
cues: Move as slowly as possible
Full available range, no momentum

name: Wall Slides
cues: Keep low back, wrists, and head against the wall

name: Isometric External Rotation (Wall Press)
cues: Elbow pinned at side
Press outward into the wall

name: Pancake Stretch (Straddle Forward Fold)
cues: Hinge from the hips, not the lower back
Feet flexed, knees pointing up

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
cues: Keep both sit bones grounded
Chest stays tall through the switch

name: Deep Squat Hold
cues: Heels stay flat if possible
Use a support if balance is limited

name: Couch Stretch (Hip Flexor)
cues: Keep hips squared forward
Squeeze the glute on the stretched side

name: Hip CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
cues: Move slowly through full range
Keep torso still, isolate the hip

name: Frog Stretch (Adductor)
cues: Knees wide, ankles in line with knees
Rock back gently, don't force it

name: Loaded Wrist Extension Hold
cues: Build load gradually, stop short of pinch pain

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
cues: Straighten the elbow for a deeper stretch
Gentle pressure, no bouncing

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization (Knee-to-Wall)
cues: Keep heel flat on the ground
Track knee straight over toes

name: Calf / Achilles Stretch
cues: Back leg straight for gastrocnemius, bent for soleus

name: Thoracic Spine Rotation (Open Book)
cues: Keep hips stacked and still
Follow the top hand with your eyes

name: Thread the Needle
cues: Reach through slowly
Let the top shoulder release toward the floor

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
cues: Slight bend in the knee is fine
Hinge from the hips

name: Towel Dead Hang
cues: Thick, unstable grip on a towel draped over the bar
Shoulders packed, don't just dead-hang limp

name: Fingertip Dead Hang
cues: Only fingers on the bar/edge, no full palm
Build up slowly - this stresses tendons, not just muscle

name: Plate Pinch Hold
cues: Pinch two plates smooth-side-out between fingers and thumb
Stand tall, don't let the plates rotate

name: Towel Pull-up
cues: Same thick unstable grip as the towel hang, now add the pull
Control the descent, don't just drop

name: Wrist Roller
cues: Roll continuously, don't let the weight drop and unwind
Do it both directions (roll up and roll down)

name: Neck Lateral Flexion Stretch
cues: Ear toward shoulder, don't shrug the shoulder up to meet it
Gentle overpressure with the hand only

name: Neck Rotation Stretch
cues: Turn the chin toward the shoulder slowly
Stop at the first resistance, don't force it

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
cues: Forearm on the frame, step through gently
Lower arm position stretches lower pec, higher stretches upper

name: Supine Lumbar Rotation (Windshield Wipers)
cues: Knees together, let them fall side to side
Keep both shoulders flat on the floor

name: Cobra Stretch (Spinal Extension)
cues: Press up through the hands, keep hips on the floor
Relax the glutes, this is a passive extension

name: Standing Quad Stretch
cues: Pull heel toward glute, knees stay together
Stand tall, don't arch the lower back to compensate

name: Lat Stretch (Hanging Side Reach)
cues: Hang from one arm, let the hip sway away from that side
Keep the shoulder packed, not jammed into the ear

name: Pigeon Pose (Hip External Rotator)
cues: Front shin angled, back leg extended straight behind
Square the hips forward as much as comfortable

name: Knee CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
cues: Slow controlled circles
Keep the movement isolated to the knee

name: Ankle Plantarflexion Stretch (Toe Point)
cues: Point the toes and hold
Add gentle overpressure with the hand
